intro.title: Introduction
intro.body: This Privacy Policy describes how FreeBusiness, referred to as we, us, or our, collects, uses, and protects information when you use our mobile application, referred to as the App.

dataWeCollect.title: Information We Collect
dataWeCollect.body: We collect your name, email address, and phone number when you register an account. We collect profile information you choose to add, including profile photos. We collect messages, images, and videos you send through the chat and group chat features of the App. We collect property listing details you submit, including descriptions, prices, and location text that you manually enter. We collect posts and comments you make on the community feed within the App.

howWeUse.title: How We Use Your Information
howWeUse.body: We use your email address to send one time passwords, referred to as OTPs, for account verification and login purposes. We use your account information to enable audio and video calling, messaging, and group chat features within the App. We use uploaded images and videos to display them within posts, chats, and property listings. We use your information to operate, maintain, and improve the App, and to communicate with you about your account.

sharing.title: Third Party Service Providers
sharing.body: We use Stream to power audio calls, video calls, and chat messaging functionality. We use Brevo to send email based one time passwords for account verification. We use Cloudinary to store and deliver images, photos, and videos uploaded through the App. We use MongoDB Atlas to securely store application data, including account information, messages, and property listings. We use RevoPush to deliver over the air updates to the App. Each of these providers processes data solely to provide their respective service to us, and may have their own privacy practices governing that data.

retention.title: Data Storage and Security
retention.body: Your information is stored on secure servers operated by our third party service providers listed above. We take reasonable measures to protect your information from unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure.

yourRights.title: Data Sharing
yourRights.body: We do not sell your personal information to third parties. We only share information with the service providers listed above as necessary to operate the App.

security.title: Your Choices
security.body: You may update or delete your profile information at any time within the App. You may contact us to request deletion of your account and associated data.

children.title: Children's Privacy
children.body: The App is not intended for children under the age of thirteen, and we do not knowingly collect information from children under thirteen.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.body: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us through the support section within the App.
